name: seblful-claude-plugins
description: Curated Claude Code plugins grouped by what they act on — Python code, any codebase, your notes, and the conversation itself.

plugins.name: python
plugins.description: Robust Python coding, testing, and notebook practices — intent-obvious code, illegal states unrepresentable, type-driven safety net, reproducible Jupyter notebooks, on top of the uv/ruff/ty/pytest stack.

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Tools that act on a codebase — a senior code-reviewer agent, a feedback-loop-first diagnosing-bugs skill, and two paired refactor commands split by what they change: /refactor-code for implementations (driven by the code-smells catalog) and /refactor-modules for interfaces and seams (driven by the codebase-design vocabulary), each auditing before touching anything — /refactor-code into a severity-tiered defect list, /refactor-modules into a visual Artifact report.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault
plugins.description: Maintenance and authoring routines for Obsidian vaults — formatting, knowledge harvesting into projects, weekly reports by project, structural scanning, accuracy review, wikilink connectivity, file cleanup, inbox ingestion, building maps of content, and authoring or rewriting source-of-truth reference notes.

plugins.name: lenses
plugins.description: Tools that act on you and the conversation rather than the code — a high-level code map (zoom-out), ultra-compressed caveman mode, one-question-at-a-time plan grilling, and a stateful multi-session teaching workspace.

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Meta-level tools that act across all your projects and on your Claude setup rather than one codebase — currently /issue: capture bugs, features, tasks, and ideas from a session as GitHub issues in the backlog repo set by CLAUDE_ISSUES_REPO (no default), dedup-checked and confirmed before filing.
